name: Screen/Admin Settings — Mod registries (Share CurseForge key)

children.name: Central management explanation
children.text: This catalog, account or installation setting belongs to the central Gameplane installation. Server actions use each server’s cluster.

children.name: Gameplane/Page Header
texts: Platform-wide configuration for this Gameplane instance.

children.name: Description
children.text: Registries that require an API key stay hidden from the Mods browser until a key is configured.

children.name: Text
children.text: Share the CurseForge key with game servers

children.name: Text
children.text: Lets servers on images without a built-in key (Minecraft 1.16.5 and older) install CurseForge packs. Mods running on those servers can read the key.

children.name: Text
children.text: Changes apply to a server when it has 0 players, so nobody is kicked by a restart.

children.name: footerText
children.text: Always available: Modrinth, Thunderstore, Hangar, Factorio, Spigot, GitHub, uMod
